english.title: Use inadequate waterbath stunner to stun poultry at a slaughterhouse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use]_
(C)_[permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use]_

a waterbath stunner to stun poultry at a slaughterhouse, namely **(..SPECIFY SLAUGHTERHOUSE..),

(D)_[when the level of the water in the waterbath had not been adjusted in order to ensure that there was good contact with each bird's head]_
(E)_[when the strength and duration of the current used was not such that the poultry were immediately rendered unconscious and remained so until dead]_
(F)_[in groups in a waterbath when the voltage sufficient to produce a current strong enough to ensure that every bird was stunned was not maintained]_
(G)_[when appropriate measures were not taken to ensure that the current passed efficiently]_
(H)_[when the waterbath stunner was not adequate in size and depth for the type of poultry being stunned]_
(I)_[when a person was not available to ascertain whether the waterbath stunner had been effective in stunning the poultry and, if it had not been effective, would either stun or kill the poultry without delay]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 30(1)(c) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 28 of Schedule 1 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
